sources: https://www.transfermarkt.co.uk/real-madrid/mitarbeiterhistorie/verein/418 (and the same page for Barcelona 131, Valencia 1049 and Atletico Madrid 13)
checks: Wikipedia's list of La Liga winning managers gives each season's champions and manager. Each was checked against Transfermarkt's staff history for the champions, which shows him in charge for that season. Most slots any one manager fills here: 2. The 2016/17 to 2025/26 window overlaps the 2010/11 one by four seasons; it is the latest ten seasons.
